column1: Aaron Burr was an American military officer and politician. A native of Connecticut, he grew up in a society divided by the struggles between English- and French-speaking factions. Burr served in the American Revolutionary War before fighting for the French side in the French and Indian War, fighting British troops in many battles in the East. In 1796, Burr was elected governor of the independent republic of West Florida. A year later, he left his native state and moved to Georgia, where he was elected to the U.S. Senate.","| Aaron Burr is a person.
